name: Flame Tongue
summary: A melee weapon that bursts into flame on command, shedding light and dealing extra Fire damage.

stats.effect: While holding this magic weapon, you can take a {ref:glossary/bonus-action} and use a command word to cause flames to engulf the damage-dealing part of the weapon. These flames shed {ref:glossary/bright-light} in a 40-foot radius and {ref:glossary/dim-light} for an additional 40 feet. While the weapon is ablaze, it deals an extra 2d6 Fire damage on a hit. The flames last until you take a Bonus Action to issue the command again or until you drop, stow, or sheathe the weapon.
